summary: Added a profile reference granularity test concluding that explicit assessed_profile references should be boundary-tiered: id+version/revision when unambiguous, authority when names can collide, digest when exact retained rules matter, and signed profile-binding only when issuer/binding verification is required.

status_change.before: archive required exported profile_conformance to be scoped by a resolvable assessed_profile but left reference strength open
status_change.after: archive defines boundary-tiered profile-reference strength without adding a universal profile manifest, registry, digest field, or signed-binding requirement

key_moves: added profile reference granularity test note
selected boundary-tiered reference strength over a global profile-reference grammar
made name-only generally too weak for exported actionable profile_conformance
reserved digests for detached, mutable, audit, safety, compliance, or long-retention boundaries
reserved signed profile-binding records for independently verified issuer/binding cases
kept profile distribution and compliance certification separate from local/export assessed state
moved the frontier to lifecycle and stale assessment handling
frontier_focus: decide profile-reference lifecycle and stale assessment handling
theme: profile references need boundary-strength binding, not a universal manifest
